title: KBSI Protein Crystallization Bank: A Comprehensive Dataset of Crystallization Conditions and Outcomes Including Failure Data
description: A large-scale dataset of protein crystallization conditions and experimental outcomes, uniquely including both successful and failed crystallization attempts. The dataset contains 1.16 million crystallization records covering 70,000+ proteins with structured condition parameters (pH, temperature, precipitant type/concentration, buffer, salt, additives) and ordinal outcome labels (clear, precipitate, phase_separation, microcrystal, single_crystal, diffraction_quality). This is the first publicly available dataset that systematically includes crystallization failure data for machine learning applications in structural biology.

methodology.data_collection: Automated harvesting from RCSB PDB (X-ray, Cryo-EM, NMR structures), TargetTrack crystallization protocols (LLM-parsed), and ChEMBL drug-target binding data.
methodology.negative_controls: Synthetic failure conditions generated from successful crystallization records using 14 perturbation strategies: extreme pH (low/high), no/excess/low precipitant, high temperature, high salt, pH shift (±1-2), temperature shift (±8-15), combined pH+temp shift, near-success microcrystal, and phase separation zones.
methodology.condition_enrichment: Free-text crystallization condition descriptions parsed to structured fields using GPT-4o-mini with JSON schema extraction.
methodology.source_tracking: All records tagged with source_db (PDB, TargetTrack, ChEMBL, KBSI, synthetic) and source_id for full provenance.
